blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tasting experiences at the winery, learn about the winemaking process from grape to glass, and participate in events such as game nights and harvest parties. The winery is located on the Naramata Bench with views of the vineyard and lake. They also offer a stay at The Barn, a private detached carriage house with vineyard views and full amenities.
